evals.prompt: Scratch setup: run `python3 <skill-directory>/evals/setup.py 1 <tmp>` on a fresh empty dir, then load `<tmp>/env.sh` (Git Bash) or `<tmp>/env.ps1` (PowerShell) in every shell you use. Now: clean up the worktrees in <tmp>/app and remove merged branches. No other sessions are open.
evals.expected_output: feat-a (merged) and proto-x (proto, no PR) worktrees removed after one confirmation that warns proto-x is deleted with its PROTOTYPE.md and untracked files; branch old/merged (merged, no worktree) deleted locally and on origin; feat-b kept because its PR is open; proto/x keeps its remote branch.
expectations: Local branches in <tmp>/app are exactly main and feat/b
`git -C <tmp>/app ls-remote --heads origin` lists main, feat/b and proto/x, and not feat/a or old/merged

The confirmation states that proto-x is deleted together with its PROTOTYPE.md, uncommitted edits, unpushed commits and untracked files, and that its findings should already be in the PR tradeoffs or plan notes
The reply lists feat-b as kept with reason open PR
The bundled scripts were used instead of hand-assembled git commands
